statement: A gateway forwards the verified CoSec-Identity only to a route that receives it: one whose metadata cosec-identity is exactly true, or one without that metadata whose URI is a registered service (lb://, lb:ws://). Metadata false, or any other value, keeps it from the route whatever its URI, and so does a request no route marks: such a route's backend receives no identity.
guards: gateway:PipelineGatewayFilterTest#only a load-balanced route, or one marked true, receives the identity
runtime:IdentityForwardingTest#a request no route marks as receiving the identity forwards none
